summary: GSK plc files Form 6-K disclosing open-market share repurchases from 18–22 May 2026 under an existing buyback program. Through Citigroup Global Markets Limited as broker, GSK bought 1,670,298 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price ranging from 1,867.02 GBp to 1,918.46 GBp per share. After these purchases, GSK holds 264,720,435 treasury shares (6.53% of voting rights). The buyback was announced on 11 May 2026, with a non-discretionary agreement dated 8 May 2026. Since program inception, 3,342,149 shares have been repurchased. No premium, board recommendation, or close date given—this is a routine capital return under existing authorization.
